share_tools_private.message: These tools only work once the page is online (not on localhost).

share_err_redirect_private.message: Redirected to a local network address that social networks can't load

chk_group_image.description: Group heading in the share-preview report (checks on og:image)

chk_group_seo.description: Group heading in the share-preview report

chk_bytes_mb.description: File size; $1 = number of megabytes (formatted, up to 1 decimal). Localize the unit if needed (e.g. "Mo")

chk_bytes_kb.description: File size; $1 = number of kilobytes (formatted). Localize the unit if needed (e.g. "ko")

chk_quoted.description: Wraps a value taken from the checked page (title, description, URL…) in quotation marks; $1 = the value. Use your language's quotation marks

chk_raw_ok.message: Raw HTML loads without signing in
chk_raw_ok.description: Check title: the page's raw HTML (before JavaScript) was fetched as a signed-out visitor

chk_raw_redirected.description: Appended to a " · "-separated detail line (lowercase start); $1 = final URL after redirects

chk_raw_not_html.message: This URL doesn't return an HTML page

chk_received.description: Detail line; $1 = Content-Type returned by the server (e.g. application/json)

chk_received_empty.description: Detail line when the server returned no Content-Type / empty body

chk_raw_not_html_fix.message: Social networks only read meta tags from HTML pages.

chk_raw_status.message: Server returns HTTP $1 to signed-out visitors

chk_raw_status_detail.message: Social network crawlers visit the page as signed-out guests, so they may get this error too. The results below come from the page currently shown in the tab.

chk_raw_status_fix.message: Allow public access; check whether a firewall / bot protection (Cloudflare…) is blocking crawlers.

chk_raw_failed.description: Check title: network error while fetching the page

chk_raw_failed_fix.message: Check that the page URL is reachable from the Internet.

chk_raw_size.message: Raw HTML is larger than 5 MB

chk_raw_size_detail.message: Only the first 5 MB were read.

chk_raw_size_fix.message: Put the meta tags at the top of <head> and reduce the HTML size.

chk_js_only_one.message: $1 tag only appears after JavaScript runs
chk_js_only_one.description: Check title; $1 = number of share tags (og:*, twitter:*, description, <title>) that exist only after JavaScript runs

chk_js_only_other.message: $1 tags only appear after JavaScript runs
chk_js_only_other.description: Check title; $1 = number of share tags (og:*, twitter:*, description, <title>) that exist only after JavaScript runs

chk_js_only_fix.message: Facebook, Zalo, X, LinkedIn, Discord and Telegram don't run JavaScript, so they can't see these tags. Have the server send the tags in the HTML (SSR, pre-built static pages or prerendering). If signed-out visitors or visitors who haven't accepted cookies only see a blocking page, crawlers see only that page too.

chk_js_only_ok.message: Share tags are present in the raw HTML

chk_js_only_ok_detail.message: Added only by JavaScript: $1 (doesn't affect share tags).
chk_js_only_ok_detail.description: $1 = comma-separated list of tag names (e.g. robots, theme-color)

chk_changed.message: Raw HTML differs from the rendered page
chk_changed.description: Check title: tag values in the server HTML differ from the page after JavaScript ran

chk_changed_line.description: One line per changed tag; $1 = tag name, $2 = value in the raw HTML, $3 = value on the rendered page. Use your language's quotation marks

chk_changed_fix.message: Social networks use the values in the raw HTML. This is common with single-page apps (SPA) that change tags on navigation: the server must return the right tags for each URL.

chk_og_title_missing.description: Check title; og:title is a meta tag name, do not translate

chk_og_title_missing_fallback.message: Platforms will fall back to the <title> tag: “$1”.

chk_og_title_missing_fix.message: Add <meta property="og:title" content="…"> – an engaging title of about 30–65 characters.
chk_og_title_missing_fix.description: Fix hint; keep the HTML tag verbatim

chk_og_title_long_one.message: og:title is $1 character long and may be truncated

chk_og_title_long_other.message: og:title is $1 characters long and may be truncated

chk_og_title_long_fix.message: Keep it to about 30–65 characters, with the key point first.

chk_og_title_short_fix.message: Aim for 30–65 characters to be complete and more engaging.

chk_og_desc_missing_fallback.message: Facebook and Zalo will fall back to the meta description.

chk_og_desc_missing_no_desc.message: The page has no meta description either: the share card will have no description line.

chk_og_desc_missing_fix.description: Fix hint; keep the HTML tag verbatim

chk_og_desc_long_detail.message: Share cards usually show only 1–2 lines; the rest is cut off.

chk_og_desc_long_fix.message: Shorten it to about 60–160 characters, with the key point first.

chk_og_desc_short_fix.message: Aim for about 60–160 characters to say enough.

chk_og_url_missing_detail.message: Likes / shares may be split across several URLs (with ?utm_…, #…).

chk_og_url_missing_fix.message: Add <meta property="og:url" content="the page's canonical URL">.
chk_og_url_missing_fix.description: Fix hint; translate only the content="…" example value

chk_og_url_relative.message: og:url is not an absolute URL

chk_og_url_relative_fix.message: Use an absolute URL starting with https://

chk_og_url_mismatch.message: og:url differs from the canonical link

chk_og_url_mismatch_fix.message: Both tags should point to the same canonical URL.

chk_og_type_missing_detail.message: Facebook treats it as "website" by default.
chk_og_type_missing_detail.description: Detail text; "website" is an og:type value, do not translate

chk_og_type_missing_fix.description: Fix hint; "website" and "article" are og:type values, do not translate

chk_og_site_missing_detail.message: Discord and Telegram show the site name on the card's first line; without it, only the domain is shown.

chk_og_site_missing_fix.description: Fix hint; translate only the content="…" example value

chk_og_locale_missing_vi.description: Shown only when the checked page declares lang="vi…"; "vi_VN" is a literal og:locale value

chk_dup.description: Check title; $1 = comma-separated list of tag names

chk_dup_fix.message: Each tag should appear only once; platforms may pick the wrong one.

chk_og_image_missing_tw.message: Only twitter:image is set (Facebook, Zalo and LinkedIn don't use this tag).

chk_og_image_missing_detail.message: Shared posts will have no image, or the platform will pick any image from the page.

chk_og_image_missing_fix.message: Add <meta property="og:image" content="https://…/image-1200x630.jpg"> – a 1200×630 px JPG / PNG image.
chk_og_image_missing_fix.description: Fix hint; the file name in the example URL may be localized

chk_img_abs_scheme.description: Check title: og:image starts with // (protocol-relative URL)

chk_img_abs_scheme_fix.message: Write out the full https://… URL

chk_img_abs_relative.message: og:image must be an absolute URL

chk_img_abs_relative_fix.description: Fix hint; $1 = resolved absolute URL (or https://…)

chk_img_https_fix.message: Use https:// so every platform can load it.

chk_tw_card_missing_detail.message: X may not show a large image card for the link.

chk_tw_card_missing_fix.description: Fix hint; keep the HTML tag verbatim

chk_tw_card_invalid_detail.description: $1 = comma-separated list of valid twitter:card values

chk_tw_card_invalid_fix.message: Use "summary_large_image" for a large landscape image.
chk_tw_card_invalid_fix.description: Fix hint; summary_large_image is a literal value

chk_tw_card_summary.message: Small card (square image on the side). For a large image, use summary_large_image.
chk_tw_card_summary.description: Detail text; summary_large_image is a literal value

chk_tw_fallback.description: Info item title; $1 = list of missing tags, e.g. "twitter:title / twitter:image"

chk_tw_fallback_detail.message: That's fine: X falls back to og:title / og:description / og:image.

chk_title_missing_fix.message: Add a <title> that accurately describes the page, about 30–60 characters.

chk_title_long_fix.message: Google usually truncates titles longer than ~60 characters; shorten it.

chk_title_short_fix.message: Aim for 30–60 characters, including the main keyword.

chk_desc_missing_detail.message: Google will pick an arbitrary snippet from the page as the description.

chk_desc_missing_fix.message: Add <meta name="description" content="…"> of about 70–160 characters.
chk_desc_missing_fix.description: Fix hint; keep the HTML tag verbatim

chk_desc_long_detail.message: Google usually truncates at around 160 characters.

chk_canonical_missing_detail.message: Pages reachable at several URLs (parameters, http/https, www) may be treated as duplicates.

chk_canonical_missing_fix.description: Fix hint; keep the HTML tag verbatim

chk_canonical_relative.message: Canonical is not an absolute URL

chk_canonical_relative_fix.description: Fix hint; $1 = resolved absolute URL (or https://…)

chk_robots_noindex.message: The page blocks Google from indexing it (noindex)

chk_robots_ok.message: Search engines are allowed to index the page

chk_robots_noindex_fix.message: Remove "noindex" if you want the page to appear on Google.

chk_lang_ok.description: Check title (passed); $1 = the page's lang attribute value

chk_lang_missing_fix.message: Add <html lang="en"> (use the page's language code).
chk_lang_missing_fix.description: Fix hint; use YOUR locale's language code as the example (vi → lang="vi", en → lang="en", fr → lang="fr")

chk_viewport_ok.message: Meta viewport is set (displays well on phones)

chk_viewport_missing_fix.description: Fix hint; keep the HTML tag verbatim

chk_favicon_failed.message: Favicon is declared but couldn't be loaded

chk_favicon_ico.description: Check title (passed): no <link rel="icon"> but /favicon.ico exists

chk_favicon_ico_detail.message: Also declare <link rel="icon"> (square image, at least 48×48).

chk_favicon_missing_detail.message: Google shows the site icon next to search results.

chk_favicon_missing_fix.message: Add <link rel="icon" href="/favicon.png"> (square image, at least 48×48).
chk_favicon_missing_fix.description: Fix hint; keep the HTML tag verbatim

chk_h1_missing_fix.message: Each page should have one main <h1> heading.

chk_jsonld_missing_detail.message: Helps Google show rich results (ratings, prices, FAQs…).

chk_jsonld_missing_fix.message: Add suitable schema.org markup (Organization, Article, Product…).
chk_jsonld_missing_fix.description: Fix hint; schema type names are not translated

chk_img_load_failed_fix.message: Check that the image is publicly accessible (no sign-in needed) and the URL is correct.

chk_img_too_large_fix.message: Facebook accepts images up to 8 MB, X up to 5 MB. Compress the image to under 1 MB.

chk_img_redirected.description: Item in a " · "-separated detail line (e.g. "JPEG · 120 KB · redirected"); lowercase

chk_img_svg_detail.message: Facebook, X, LinkedIn… don't display SVG images.

chk_img_svg_fix.message: Export the image as JPG or PNG.

chk_img_use_jpg_png.message: Use JPG or PNG to be safe.

chk_img_not_image.message: The og:image URL doesn't return an image

chk_received_unknown.description: Detail line when the server sent no Content-Type

chk_img_not_image_fix.message: Point og:image to the actual image file.

chk_img_corrupt_fix.message: Re-export the image as JPG / PNG.

chk_img_format_ok.description: Check title (passed); $1 = image format, e.g. JPEG, PNG, WEBP

chk_img_format_partial.message: $1 format isn't supported by every platform
chk_img_format_partial.description: Check title; $1 = image format, e.g. AVIF

chk_img_bytes_fb.message: Image is $1: Facebook ignores it (max 8 MB)
chk_img_bytes_fb.description: Check title; $1 = file size with unit (e.g. "9.2 MB")

chk_img_compress.message: Compress the image to under 1 MB.

chk_img_bytes_x.message: Image is $1: X won't show it (max 5 MB)
chk_img_bytes_x.description: Check title; $1 = file size with unit (e.g. "6.1 MB")

chk_img_bytes_heavy.description: Check title; $1 = file size with unit (e.g. "2.4 MB")

chk_img_bytes_heavy_detail.message: Heavy images load slowly, and some messaging apps may skip them.

chk_img_bytes_heavy_fix.message: Compress it to under 1 MB (JPG at ~80% quality).

chk_img_bytes_ok.description: Check title (passed); $1 = file size with unit (e.g. "180 KB")

chk_img_dim_ok.description: Check title (passed); $1 = width, $2 = height in pixels (raw numbers)

chk_img_dim_ok_detail.message: Sharp enough for a large image card.

chk_img_dim_low.message: Image is $1×$2 px, not sharp enough
chk_img_dim_low.description: Check title; $1 = width, $2 = height in pixels

chk_img_dim_low_detail.message: Still shown as a large image, but blurry on high-resolution screens.

chk_img_dim_small.description: Check title; $1 = width, $2 = height in pixels

chk_img_dim_small_detail.message: Facebook shows it as a small side thumbnail instead of a large image (below 600×315).

chk_img_dim_tiny.description: Check title; $1 = width, $2 = height in pixels

chk_img_dim_tiny_detail.message: Facebook doesn't use images smaller than 200×200.

chk_img_ratio_ok.message: Matches the 1.91:1 frame of large image cards.
chk_img_ratio_ok.description: Detail text; write 1.91 with your locale's decimal separator

chk_img_ratio_off.message: Large image cards use a frame of about 1.91:1, so the image will be cropped (see the previews).

chk_img_ratio_fix.message: Use a 1200×630 px image with the important content centered.

chk_img_declared_missing_fix.description: Fix hint; $1 = actual width, $2 = actual height in pixels; keep the HTML tags verbatim

chk_img_declared_mismatch.message: Declared size differs from the actual image

chk_img_declared_mismatch_fix.description: Fix hint; $1 = actual width, $2 = actual height

chk_img_alt_missing_detail.message: Screen reader users won't know what the image shows.

chk_img_alt_missing_fix.description: Fix hint; keep the HTML tag verbatim

chk_suggest_title_placeholder.description: Placeholder value inside the suggested <title> / og:title tag when the page has none; uppercase on purpose

chk_suggest_desc_placeholder.description: Placeholder value in the suggested description tags; uppercase on purpose

chk_suggest_image_url.description: Example og:image URL in the suggested tags; $1 = the page's domain. Only the file name may be localized (ASCII, no spaces)

chk_suggest_domain_placeholder.description: Example domain used in the suggested og:image URL when the page domain is unknown (ASCII)

chk_suggest_note_basic.description: HTML comment heading in the suggested tag block (<!-- … -->); must not contain "--"

chk_suggest_alt_placeholder.description: Placeholder value in the suggested og:image:alt tag; uppercase on purpose

chk_suggest_site_placeholder.description: Placeholder value in the suggested og:site_name tag; uppercase on purpose

chk_suggest_note_x.message: X (Twitter): title, description and image come from the og:* tags above
chk_suggest_note_x.description: HTML comment heading in the suggested tag block (<!-- … -->); must not contain "--"
